purpose: Define the exact intake record required before a corrected or replacement property evidence fixture can enter admission review.

current_intake.reason: No corrected or replacement fixture has been submitted.

rules: An intake record is not evidence.
Privacy or meaning-preservation failure blocks admission.
A source-derived fixture remains a controlled fixture unless separately governed as production evidence.
No dependent revalidation may execute before APPROVED.
guardrails: Do not invent candidate fixture content.
Do not claim live official retrieval.
Do not establish real property ownership, title or boundaries.
Do not upgrade legal verification or publication readiness.
